g.text: Lab 08 · Latency during a Redis outage, by client and setting

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #666666

g.text: Every client is configured with 500 ms timeouts (dashed). What a request actually waits depends on the client and the outage kind.
